say:0:1533301001:0.text: A stone slab is mounted on the door before you: "Cannot be opened from this side."
say:0:1533301001:0.source_cn: 眼前的门上挂着一块石板：门不能从这一侧打开。
say:0:1533301001:0.male: A stone slab is mounted on the door before you: "Cannot be opened from this side."
say:0:1533301001:0.female: A stone slab is mounted on the door before you: "Cannot be opened from this side."

say:1:1533301002:0.text: A door that can only be opened from the inside? How peculiar. Stubborn as you are, you give the door a firm pull, then a push—nothing budges.
say:1:1533301002:0.source_cn: 一扇只能从里面打开的门？有意思。倔强的你抬手拉了下门，...
say:1:1533301002:0.male: A door that can only be opened from the inside? How peculiar. Stubborn as you are, you give the door a firm pull, then a push—nothing budges.
say:1:1533301002:0.female: A door that can only be opened from the inside? How peculiar. Stubborn as you are, you give the door a firm pull, then a push—nothing budges.

say:2:1533301003:0.text: The door itself looks perfectly ordinary. Maybe whoever's inside just doesn't want to answer. Whether out of curiosity or sheer boredom, you decide to knock.
say:2:1533301003:0.source_cn: 但这扇门看起来好无异常，也许只是门内的人不想开门。或许...
say:2:1533301003:0.male: The door itself looks perfectly ordinary. Maybe whoever's inside just doesn't want to answer. Whether out of curiosity or sheer boredom, you decide to knock.
say:2:1533301003:0.female: The door itself looks perfectly ordinary. Maybe whoever's inside just doesn't want to answer. Whether out of curiosity or sheer boredom, you decide to knock.

say:0:1533302001:0.text: No response... can't blame them. You never answer your door either.
say:0:1533302001:0.source_cn: 一点声音也没有……没人听到敲门？
say:0:1533302001:0.male: No response... can't blame them. You never answer your door either.
say:0:1533302001:0.female: No response... can't blame them. You never answer your door either.

say:0:1533303001:0.text: But still... If the door only opens from within, someone must be inside.
say:0:1533303001:0.source_cn: 如果门只能从里面打开，那屋里肯定有人。
say:0:1533303001:0.male: But still... If the door only opens from within, someone must be inside.
say:0:1533303001:0.female: But still... If the door only opens from within, someone must be inside.

narration:0:1533304001:0.text: You throw your whole weight into pounding on the door!
narration:0:1533304001:0.source_cn: 你用尽全身力气，拼命地敲着门！
narration:0:1533304001:0.male: You throw your whole weight into pounding on the door!
narration:0:1533304001:0.female: You throw your whole weight into pounding on the door!

say:2:1533304002:0.text: Who is it?! Why do you keep knocking like that?! Stop banging on my door!
say:2:1533304002:0.source_cn: 谁啊！！！一直在那里敲敲敲，为什么一直敲我家门！

say:3:1533304003:0.text: Didn't you read? This door can't be opened from your side!!
say:3:1533304003:0.source_cn: 不都说了，这扇门没法从这边打开吗！！！
